title: automil result.json contract (D-201, DEC-03)
description: Contract every training script must honor. Validated at ingestion in src/automil/backends/_orchestrator_daemon.py. additionalProperties is intentional; consumers may extend.

termination_reason.description: Free-form reason for non-completed terminal state. Known values: timeout, oom, sigterm, sigkill, unknown. Not an enum — consumers may extend. Added 2026-06-10 (D-05, REC-03). No schema version bump: change is additive-only; additionalProperties:true already set. Existing result.json files with status=completed|crash|budget_killed|cancelled continue to validate. Schema versioning (for breaking changes) is tracked in DBT-01 / Phase 14.
